title: cairn install lays the skills
intention: cairn install links ~/.claude/skills/<s> to <this checkout>/skills/<s> for every Cairn skill (a skills/<s>/ holding SKILL.md), on every box. It uses a symlink on POSIX and a directory junction on Windows. A correct link is left alone, a link to another checkout is re-pointed, a dangling link into a skills/ dir is removed, and a same-named real directory is reported RED and never touched.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: akienasus had none of the 15 Cairn skills and akiendell none of the 16, and both were linked by hand. A box without the skills cannot fire /idea, /intent, /sorted or /sail, so the workflow does not exist there.
traces_to: Law 1: a box's skill set is derived from skills/*/SKILL.md, never re-derived by hand on each box. Law 4: the link is laid by the installer's code, not by a remembered step.
how: Add ensure_skill_links(*, skills_src=None, skills_root=None, link=None, dry_run=False) beside ensure_journal_merge_driver in installer.py, returning {id:'skill-links', status, detail}, and call it from main(). The proof drives it over scratch dirs with an injected link-maker.

clauses.claim: over an empty skills root, one link per skill dir holding SKILL.md resolves to <src>/skills/<s>, and none is made for __pycache__ or a dir without SKILL.md
a second run reports already_applied and changes nothing
a same-named real directory is reported red and left untouched, a link to another checkout is re-pointed, and a dangling link into a skills/ dir is removed
dry_run reports offered and writes nothing

decisions.text: D1: ensure_skill_links in installer.py. The skills root is $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills if set, else ~/.claude/skills. A link counts as correct when Path.resolve() equals the target (os.path.islink reads False for a junction). The maker defaults to os.symlink(target_is_directory=True) on POSIX and `cmd /c mklink /J` on Windows; removal is os.unlink on POSIX and os.rmdir for a junction. main() appends its result right after ensure_journal_merge_driver, passing dry_run.
D2: the proof builds a fixture skills tree and a scratch skills root in tmp, with one tooth per clause (PROVES 1-4) and an injected link-maker.
D3: the installer charter names skill links among the steps it performs in code, through the artifact door.

measured.saw: akienasus had 0 of 15 Cairn skills linked and akiendell 0 of 16; both were linked by hand, and junctions load without a restart on akiendell
measured.how: the orchestrator's relay of ls ~/.claude/skills on each box, and akiendell_cc_0's measurement
